rows.name: save/load roundtrip: default battery fields are strict and preserved
save/load roundtrip: in-progress recharge and partial charge survive
legacy snapshot: absent battery fields are migrated on a clone, original untouched
validateSnapshot/migrateSnapshot never mutate the caller object
present-but-null or invalid battery is NOT replaced by migration defaults
save rejects null / negative / excess / NaN battery fields
invalid recharge state / position / duration are rejected
exhausted battery with pumpRunning true is rejected (running/depleted contradiction)
corrupt primary still recovers the previous-good backup (with battery fields)
